## Question 1

output.answer_1: I used 2 of the small triangle tiles placed together along their longest sides (hypotenuses) to form one large black triangle. In the figure, I would shade two adjacent small triangles that share a common long edge, forming a single larger triangle.
output.answer_2: I used all 4 triangle tiles to make a black square. In the 2 by 2 grid, I would shade the four small triangles of one 2 by 2 block's worth of tiles so that they fit together to form one black square, shading the chosen four triangles that together make a square shape in the grid.
output.answer_3: Answer: 1/4. The large figure has 16 small triangles in total, and the black square made from 4 triangle tiles covers 4 of them, so 4 out of 16 is 4/16, which equals 1/4.
